text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. At its core, AI relies on machine learning, where computers learn from large amounts of data instead of following fixed instructions. A more advanced form is deep learning, which uses complex neural networks to process information almost like a human brain would. You already interact with AI daily: voice assistants like Siri, movie recommendations on Netflix, and spam filters in email all use these technologies. As AI improves, it is becoming a quiet helper in many areas of modern life.
